author: Sister Aelfrun
pages:
Seventh shrine of my road. I left a candle and a copper for every traveller who has passed this way and not come home.

My cough is worse. The priests said the walking would cure it. The priests say many things.

I can no longer climb to the next shrine. I will rest here a while and then go down to the village and find someone to carry my candles the rest of the way. Whoever finds this: the road matters more than the end of it. Light one for me.
